teacher_info.about_teacher:
After obtaining TEFL Certification from the Language Institute at Chiang Mai University I taught classes at Pro Language Chiang Mai in 2008. I remained there until returning home from Thailand in February of 2009. Since then I have done private English tutoring in Thailand, Mexico, and United States. 

More recently, I taught English conversation and grammar lessons to students enrolled in Tutlo Online English School, based out of Poland, from 2020 to 2022.
teacher_info.teaching_style: I find that the best way to learn a language is to acquire it through conversation. My skill as a teacher is to adjust to each student's level. Whether you are a beginner at learning English, or are an advanced student, we will communicate and improve your skills. My lesson for this method is "Let's Chat" which is an informal conversation lesson. I do not teach grammar in most of my lessons, however, if you would like to practice some, please let me know and we can spend a portion of our lesson doing some exercises to learn more about your strenghts and weaknesses.

In my Business English classes, I bring my business acumen into the classroom. I leverage my own experience to relate to students' needs.
In my conversation classes, we take it easy and explore topics that students enjoy: cute pets, artificial intelligence, money, travel, or whatever it may be.

pro_course_detail.title: Supremo Latin American Spanish
pro_course_detail.description:
This is a unique opportunity for you since I am American and English is my first language. My Spanish is near-native. That means that I'm not just fluent in Spanish, but quite often I am mistaken for a native speaker and because of how well I speak and interact in Spanish many natives are surprised that I'm American. 

Since there are so many native Spanish speakers on italki, why take classes with me? teacher_info.about_teacher: I love teaching and helping students to feel more comfortable and confident speaking English in real-world conversations.  I am also a language learner. My teaching style is relational, I am invested in my students and I am so excited to see you gaining confidence in your speaking ability!
teacher_info.teaching_style: My adult lessons are conversation-based and thematic.  Each lesson will be centered on a topic and I will ask you related discussion questions.  I can provide you with questions before class so that you can prepare, if that makes you more comfortable.  The classes are relaxed and feel much like having a conversation with a friend. I will also include important grammar points and pronunciation points when they arise in class.  I will also provide you with new vocabulary and phrases/idioms during each class so that your vocabulary is always expanding. Some examples of class topics are: introductions, hobbies, free time, sports, movies, books, food, family, holidays, music, and many more!
